title: Eyebrow
description: A small uppercase kicker label with wide tracking that sits above a heading, figure or section.

lead.description: A short hairline dash before the text. Ignored when `icon` is set.

icon.description: Decorative icon before the text, about 1.25× the text size. Hidden from assistive tech.

tone.description: Colours only the rule or icon (text.brand, accent.text or the feedback fg role). The label stays text.subtle.

as.description: p above a heading or section; span inside other text or flex rows.

children.description: Two to four words. Write it in sentence case; CSS sets the capitals. On the wire: a string.

fallback.description: Rendered instead of this node by a client that doesn't know its type. Must be a node that client knows.

x-syntara-rule.message: An Eyebrow needs text in children.
